cards.text: This is the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite, and it's a burden against Nineveh, the same great city Jonah once warned (Jonah 3:3-4). Nahum doesn't warm up with small talk, friend. He goes STRAIGHT to who God is.
First line out of the gate: the LORD is a jealous and avenging God, full of wrath, who takes vengeance on His foes. And this is the same God Jonah once called gracious and compassionate (Jonah 4:2).

cards.question: Nahum says this jealous and avenging God is quick to anger.
The LORD is slow to anger. But what does Nahum say He will do about the guilty?

answers.text: He will forget them over time
He will let them all go free

cards.text: Then Nahum paints a picture: His path is in the whirlwind and storm, and clouds are the dust beneath His feet. Friend, I've got a gold base stuck to my feet and I STILL trip walking to the oven.

cards.question: Storms for a road and clouds for dust. That picture shows how great the LORD's ___ is.

cards.text: He rebukes the sea and dries it up, and Bashan and Carmel wither. Me? I rebuke my dough for not rising and it just sits there LOOKING at me.

cards.question: When the LORD shows up, what does Nahum say the mountains do?

cards.text: Then Nahum asks, 'Who can withstand His indignation? Who can endure His burning anger?' Friend, I open a hot oven door and I flinch. Imagine standing in front of THAT.

cards.question: In Nahum's picture, God's wrath is poured out like fire, and even rocks are shattered before Him.

cards.text: Then, right in the middle of all that thunder, Nahum says the LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress. It's like a storm rattling the whole street, and you've got a solid brick house to run into.

cards.question: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress. Who does Nahum say He cares for?

cards.text: Then Nahum says the LORD will make an end of Nineveh and pursue His enemies into darkness. Running into the dark won't help, friend. He follows.

cards.question: With an overwhelming ___, the LORD will make an end of Nineveh.

cards.text: Then Nahum says that whatever you plot against the LORD, He will bring to an end. You can plan all night long. He decides where it stops.

cards.question: Nahum says whatever is plotted against the LORD, He will bring to an end. Then he talks about affliction. He says it will rise up a second time.

cards.text: Then Nahum stacks up the pictures. They'll be tangled up as with thorns, and consumed like the drink of a drunkard. Friend, I got my mustache tangled in a whisk ONE time and I'm still not over it. Thorns? No thank you.

cards.question: Nahum has one more picture. They'll be consumed like stubble that is fully ___.

cards.text: Then Nahum speaks right to the city: from Nineveh comes a plotter of evil against the LORD, a counselor of wickedness. Plotting against the LORD? That's a cookie drawing up battle plans against the OVEN.
Now the LORD Himself speaks. And when the LORD says something, friend, you put the cookie DOWN and you listen.

cards.question: The LORD talks about those who are allied and numerous. What does He say will happen to them?

answers.text: They will be cut down and gone
They will be spared this time

cards.question: Then the LORD turns to Judah, the kingdom that stayed with David's family (1 Kings 12:20). He says He has afflicted Judah, but He will afflict them no longer.
The LORD says He will now tear away Judah's shackles. What will He break from Judah's neck?

cards.text: Then the LORD issues a command concerning Nineveh: He will cut off the carved image and cast idol from the house of its gods. Those idols are getting cleared out like a junk drawer on cleaning day, and friend, I spent YEARS dreading that day.

cards.question: The LORD issues a command concerning Nineveh. In it, He says Nineveh will have descendants to carry on its name.
No descendants and no idols. What does the LORD say He will prepare for Nineveh?

cards.text: Then Nahum says look to the mountains: here come the feet of someone bringing good news, proclaiming peace. I know that feeling, friend: the drawer slides open and the light pours in.

cards.question: Good news and peace are on the way. What does Nahum tell Judah to do?
Nahum tells Judah the wicked will never again march through them.
